title: Bank of Punjab First Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: Bank of Punjab First Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

BANK OF PUNJAB
BANK OF PUNJAB
(FIRST AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2003
ACT II OF 2003
An Act further to
amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab.
Extraordinary, 8th February. 2003]
Na.PAP-Legis-2(3)/2003/428,
dated 8-2-2003.--The Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Bill, 2003, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 7th February, 2003 and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 8th February 2003, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the Bank of Punjab (First Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment in section 10 of

"Government".
